title: How Bright Ears Uses Gmail Send-Only Access
description: Reviewed Sprint 1 plan for Google's OAuth verification demonstration. This manifest must not be captured without fresh action-time approval.

sources.source: app/(marketing)/privacy/page.tsx and components/mailbox-card.tsx at the recorded production commit

scenes.title: Gmail acts only as the delivery transport.
bullets: Bright Ears requests gmail.send plus openid and email
No Gmail reading, listing or importing
scenes.narration: This demonstration shows the complete Bright Ears OAuth grant and how Gmail is used only to send an owner-approved message.

scenes.title: The product explains the boundary first.
scenes.narration: Before connecting, Bright Ears explains that it can send but never read Gmail, and that Google API data never goes to an AI provider.

actions.instruction: Hold on the complete Bright Ears pre-consent disclosure long enough to read it.

scenes.title: Google shows the exact requested permission.
scenes.narration: The complete English Google consent screen identifies Bright Ears and shows the send-email permission. No mailbox-reading permission is requested.

actions.instruction: Verify the bottom-left language is English; show the full consent screen and the send-email scope; choose the already authenticated founder account and grant consent. Do not enter credentials while recording.

scenes.title: One test message proves send-only transport.
scenes.narration: With separate explicit approval for this test, Bright Ears sends a sample only to the connected founder address. No venue or customer is contacted.

scenes.title: Draft first. Transport second.
bullets: Drafts use Bright Ears profile, Postmark inbound and public venue data
Connected email, OAuth tokens and Gmail message IDs stay out of OpenRouter
OpenRouter routing requires data collection denied and zero retention
scenes.narration: AI drafts use data supplied to Bright Ears, Postmark inbound messages, and public venue information. Google account data stays in the separate Gmail transport path.

scenes.title: The Limited Use disclosure is public.
scenes.narration: The public privacy policy states the Google Limited Use commitment and the separation of Google API data from AI providers.

actions.selector: text=Google Limited Use and separation from AI providers
text=Google Limited Use and separation from AI providers

actions.instruction: Hold on the full Google Limited Use section long enough to read it.
